image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) standing on gravelly ground. The bird is in non-breeding or female plumage, featuring a speckled brownish-grey head and back, a distinct orange-rufous breast and flanks, and a white belly. The wings show black feathers with prominent orange/rufous edges and white wing bars. The bill is conical, yellow at the base and dark at the tip. The legs are pinkish-brown and slender.
